FEMM 2D magnetostatic · no-load · verification against Ansys Motor-CAD

Spoke V2 back-EMF verification

An independent finite-element check of the open-circuit back-EMF of E:\Spoke_V2\ADAPTIVE_MODEL_COMPLETE_4.mot, a 12-slot / 10-pole ferrite spoke motor. Every input used is listed below so it can be compared field by field with the Motor-CAD model.

Solver: FEMM 4.2 via pyfemmRun: 10 Oct 2026Magnets: 20 °CSpeed basis: 1000 rpmRotor sweep: 0–72° mech, 2° steps (36 solves per case)

The 11th harmonic (slot harmonic of 12 slots / 10 poles) dominates. Triplen harmonics cancel in the star line-line voltage.

EMF = −dψ/dt from the FEMM flux linkage, using a central difference over the 36 rotor positions (10° electrical apart). The step is fine enough for rms and fundamental values; the sharper ripple of the slot harmonic is smoothed slightly.

At no load the magnet's lowest H (-245 kA/m) is well inside HcJ (−432 kA/m at 20 °C), so there is no demagnetisation risk. The bridges are fully saturated, as intended.

Sampled at 2° mech. The cogging period is 6° mech (LCM(12,10) = 60), so this curve is undersampled and gives only an indication of the peak-to-peak value. Run a dedicated cogging analysis at 0.25° steps if you need it.

Mean turn length = 2 × 63 mm active + 75.615 mm end-winding MLT (front + rear) = 201.62 mm. Coil length = 2016.2 mm. Copper mass from these lengths = 1.474 kg (Motor-CAD 1.474 kg). Per phase = 2 coils in series ÷ 2 parallel paths = 1 coil. DC only: no AC or proximity effect, no lead or busbar resistance.

9Comparing with Motor-CAD

E(n, T) = 8.26 V × (n / 1000 rpm) × [1 − 0.0018 × (Tmagnet − 20)] phase rms
ELL(n, T) = 14.31 V × (n / 1000 rpm) × [1 − 0.0018 × (Tmagnet − 20)] line-line rms, star
Set Motor-CAD the same way before comparing
  • Magnet temperature 20 °C in the E-Magnetics calculation (or scale with the formula above).
  • Compare the same quantity: phase or line-line, rms or peak, star or delta.
  • Expect FEMM to be within about 1–3 %. The remaining differences come from the M235-35A B-H curve, the unmodelled fillets (slot corner 1.95 mm; pocket, magnet and lamination fillets) and mesh density.

Not modelled

  • Fillet radii (slot corner, pocket, magnet, lamination) and the rotor lamination inset parameter.
  • 3D end effects: axial leakage of the spoke rotor and end-winding flux. 2D and Motor-CAD 2D FEA both leave these out.
  • Magnet non-linearity near the knee (it is not reached at no load).
